title: Little Shops
content: The five-stars is for real! What I found is that Temu consists of many little shops that you’re purchasing from. So, yes, the items are made and shipped from China, BUT, I like the fact that I’m supporting many “little shops” instead of just big stores like the U.S. has. What I have learned is that there are many of these little shops that sell “fakes”, or replicas of the same well-made item at another little store on Temu. (So Temu is similar to EBay, but without bidding, and much more affordable!) You may want to make a list of the stores you get good items from, so when you reorder, you don’t get a non-legit item (or fake). I have fun just adding cool things to my Wishlist: on item, scroll down, passed the reviews, and you’ll see the little empty heart and “wishlist “ by that. Tap heart to save in your wishlist.

Natürlich sollte man sich vor dem Kauf Produktbeschreibung, Maße und Bewertungen genau ansehen, da Qualität und Verarbeitung je nach Artikel unterschiedlich ausfallen können.

Insgesamt bietet Temu für mich ein gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis und eine unkomplizierte Bestellmöglichkeit. Aufgrund meiner bisherigen Erfahrungen würde ich dort wieder bestellen

title: Pay Close Attention To The Listed Product Dimensions
content: If you pay close attention to the listed product dimensions, you won’t be terribly disappointed. I have purchased a WIDE variety of products from Temu and learned quickly that I MUST read the measurements of the item before selecting it. Once I started doing that, along with reading reviews, I haven’t been disappointed as often as I had been. Actually, some of those early purchases gave me great & hilarious stories to share! I play the daily return to gain your prize promotion & have received a lot of great stuff for free. I still don’t understand the “pre-claim” free items yet. I figure, if it doesn’t show in my cart as an addition that’s free, I just click out because I have been burnt by purchasing items in the required amount necessary but unsure if I was receiving the free items or not. The site is great but can be EXTREMELY confusing as to what you get for what you spin. It’s like there’s two totally different “carts” depending on promotion. It’s annoying. The rules don’t list out the exact pre-claim definition so I have been too chicken to purchase the cart filled that completes the requirement. Again, if it’s not listed as free in my cart, it doesn’t exist so I don’t complete that purchase & just leave them there for future reference. I do love the site but every purchase does feel a bit like a gamble, hoping I receive something of relatively good quality. Lately, I have received higher quality items & have been pleased. Just read every detail & you’ll like it too!

title: DESESPERANTE
content:
⭐☆☆☆☆

La experiencia de compra se ha vuelto desesperante.

Cada vez que abres un enlace o intentas ver un producto, la app te obliga a pasar por una interminable secuencia de “rifas”, “premios”, “gira la rueda”, “raspa y gana” y otras pantallas diseñadas para retrasarte. Literalmente puedes tardar mas de dos de minutos esperando solo para llegar a la página principal y, hasta entonces, por fin ver el producto que querías desde el principio, si es que lo logras.

Entiendo que quieran promocionar ofertas, pero esto ya no se siente como marketing, sino como una estrategia para manipular el tiempo de uso de la aplicación y simular descuentos mediante tácticas de gamificación excesivas.

Si alguien abre Temu es porque quiere comprar o consultar un artículo, no jugar un videojuego para poder acceder al catálogo. Debería existir una opción clara para omitir todas esas promociones con un solo toque.

Mientras no prioricen la experiencia del usuario sobre sus métricas de engagement, seguiré considerando esta una de las experiencias de navegación más frustrantes entre las apps de comercio electrónico.

title: Great deals and features, but watch out for misleading listings and annoying pop-ups.
content:
The Temu app is full of great values and unique features, but it definitely requires you to be a careful shopper. You have to pay close attention to the product descriptions because items are often presented visually larger than they actually are. Additionally, the list pricing can be very misleading; listings frequently display the price for the lowest quantity while showing a photo and description of the highest quantity—like showing a 100-count pack of pens with a $20 price, but when you open the item, the $20 price is for a 20-count option. Opening the app can also be a chore, as you’re instantly bombarded with intrusive, time-consuming animations for coupons and discounts that require a purchase to use, taking multiple clicks just to dismiss.
That being said, the perks keep me coming back. I really appreciate the $5 on-time delivery guarantee and the excellent price adjustment feature, which lets you request a partial refund if an item’s price drops after you buy it. Being able to buy customized items without minimum orders or setup fees is also a huge plus. The app is honestly kind of addicting, and I will definitely continue to use it despite the annoying quirks.

title: Read carefully the descriptions
content:
Not happy with Temu.  A lot of cheap and poor quality goods that look good in photos but are generally a lot smaller than pictured.  A lot of unfair marketing practices encouraging people to buy more.  4 items for free, but after selecting my choices I then he ad to purchase a lot of goods to obtain the free items.  When buying the required items and paying for them I then discovered that I would only receive one free item and would have to make further purchases on another day to get the next item free. A big con as I tested this buy adding further items to a certain amount to my basket only to be offer a small discount of less than £2 with no mention of the next free item.    In all fairness, some of the items I have purchased have been good quality at a fair price but also a lot of rubbish goods.  Yesterday I received a batch of 50 paint brushes plainly showing 1” on the metal binding but only measure just under 20mm and the laughable part is that there was more loose bristles in the delivery bag than there was in the brushes.  They went straight into my rubbish bin.
Best tip I can offer is double read and study the description before buying especially delivery times as some items will be shipped overland from the other side of the planet.
Happy shopping and be careful.

content:

Overall I have had a very pleasant experience with Temu.
Thank you.

title: At times infuriating
content:
I came to Temu after no one would ship to me on AliExpress. I never had this issue until right around the time Trump put tariffs on China. After that 99% of items cannot be shipped to me. And so far I have not been able to get any sort of explanation as to why.

So that’s the backstory of how I got here. The app is ok. Funding terms is easy and there’s always something interesting but you need to read very carefully everything and if the description doesn’t tell you everything about the item then walk away.  If you want quality then you will pay up for it.  If something seems too good to be true it usually is. Sometimes you get lucky on the cheap items and get something useful but that’s like 1 out of ten. The retail prices they list are a joke. Like $159 for a mop but their prices is $13. So you are getting an amazing deal right? Definitely look at the dimensions of an item. They are photographed and sometimes shopped to look much larger then actually are. Also read read read the reviews of products and learn to filter out the bot reviews that are always giving 5 stars.

The worst thing about this app is all the sneaky deals they shove in your face and you need to listen to their BS before you can escape. Most of the time. You will be required to spend upwards of $400 to get a big reward. If you may not have to spend more than $44 to get a few free pics. It’s from a limited pool of Items.

title: Tolle Shoppingapp - kleines Aber …
content: Ich war anfangs skeptisch, die Erst- und Zweitbestellung haben mich aber überzeugt! Kleidung und Sachen mit Stecker würde ich aus Überzeugung lieber nicht kaufen, da hier die Qualität und Elektroprüfungen nicht meinem Ansprüchen genügen können, bei Haushaltsartikeln, Fahrzeugpflege, Kamerazubehör und Bürobedarf bin ich aber ganz klarer Fan geworden! Die Artikel sind erschreckenderweise zum größten Teil mit dem Sortiment von eBay und Amazon deckungsgleich, nur viel viel günstiger! Der Versand ist in der Regel bisher sehr zuverlässig gewesen und die Verpackung der Artikel gut! Der einzige Makel: die Aktionen nerven etwas (gut man könnte sich ja abschalten, aber dann verpasst man ein paar gute Schnapper). Innerhalb der Aktionen gibt es sehr günstige aber deutlich eingeschränkte Auswahl - auch der „Suchenbutton“ fehlt und man wird deutlich länger am Scrollen nach Artikeln in der App gehalten. Naja … wie gesagt: kleines Manko!

title: Magnets are great!
content: I have used Temu several years. I learned from a friend to verify sizes before ordering anything and have had no problems there. I have had both returns and refunds with no problems if they were from Temu but if you order from a “Lical” shipper in the USA you are pretty much on your own. They have updated so now you can contact the 3rd party so it may be easier now. I ordered litter a few years ago and only received 1 of the 3 containers ( you could only order sets of 3). I should have read the reviews and I would have known better. Be a shrewd shopper. 1) check the listed size and do not order if there is any doubt 2) be sure to check the reviews, especially the low stars ones and see if people are using products or rating when the package comes 3) do check you products, most stores will gladly send missing parts or exchange items. 4) The MAGNETS ( real/ natural ones) are great and I even got the tiny ones for magnet boards and had to pull hard to get them apart. The others I bought stick to ceiling nails soundly and metal frames of doors. I bought some tiny ones for craft/ fridge decorations are they occasionally will slide if overloaded but can hold 3 sheets grandkid art without a problem ( you may initially have trouble pulling them apart if they are less than 0.5mm because of their strength. Happy Shopping!

title: Swamped with poor quality AI generated items
content: I’ve used Temu on and off over the years and it’s always been a bit risky with some things being fantastic value and others being absolutely atrocious quality. I understand this is the nature of a wholesaler with multiple sellers to a degree. However in the past year or so the app has been absolutely flooded with very poor AI generated items. Cushions, canvases, rugs, you name it. Whatever it is it’s got a poor quality AI generated print. My issue is that there’s absolutely no regulation from Temu, there should be a mandatory ai generated label on items that have used it or something. You’re only allowed 1 free return on your account so I’m going to uninstall as I can’t risk buying unmarked ai generated slop then getting punished for returning something undeclared. In addition to the AI issue there’s lots of misleading images like pretending something is attached only to see its printed on with a fake printed drop shadow and other examples of shady and poor business. This doesn’t even cover the terrible user experience and interface with the misleading ‘offers’ you’re absolutely spammed with as soon as you open the app that offer hundreds of pounds discount but don’t disclose that you have to do xyz first and purchase then getting punished your purchase shipped and then lo and behold the goalpost is moved again.

title: Does temu think I’m stupid?
content: I used a “get up to 90% off” and got 86% off, and found an endoscope, and found out I’m paying a slight mark up. Good thing I didn’t order it before looking at the same one in my cart. The same one in my cart was less than 13 dollars, and with the 86% off, I found that the item cost a little more. Temu tries to make you feel like you’re getting a better deal, but you’re actually paying a markup. Update: I tried the 99.9 percent off offer, and paid what it said to pay. It says only 7 dollars left, I added a 9 dollar item, and then it said 6.55 left?! It’s clearly trying to nickel and dime me. I’m canceling those orders and then deleting this disrespectful and deceptive app from my device. I thought I could get good deals, but as it turns out, they try to scam you blind. I might be stupid, but not that stupid. And I better be able to cancel these orders, That have been placed with just one click, and no confirmation option, and then got me by surprise. It should ask if I’m sure I want to check out for prize and show how much is left, not just place the order without my consent. I guess Chinese companies like to trick you into buying something you didn’t consent to. I just tried Ali express, and it gave me 2 welcome gifts, nothing expensive, but the app seems true to itself. What I like to see, is transparency, not opaqueness. And temu is a perfect example of opaqueness. Hopefully Ali express won’t stiff me like this one did.

title: Well designed shopping application
content:

Temu is a well-designed and user-friendly shopping app that offers a smooth and enjoyable experience. The interface is clean and intuitive, with bright, high-quality product images that make browsing fun and engaging.

Clear Pricing & Product Display: Prices are easy to understand, with no hidden costs. You can zoom in and out on product images for better detail, and even compare items side by side.

Fun Extras: The app includes small games that add a light, fun element to the shopping experience—great for lifting your mood.
Customer Service: Customer support is responsive and efficient. Refunds are processed quickly and without unnecessary back-and-forth.
Wide Product Range: There’s a huge selection of items across categories like home goods, clothing, pet supplies, and more.
Easy Payments & Fast Refunds: Payments are hassle-free with options like Apple Pay and Klarna. Refunds are also quick and painless.
Shipping: Standard delivery time is around 3 weeks, which is reasonable considering the variety and low prices.

Overall Impression:

Temu is a surprisingly powerful app packed with useful features, especially for the price-conscious shopper. Between the vast selection, clear pricing, fun extras, and strong customer support, it’s definitely worth trying out.

author: MikePD in GB

title: A welcome surprise amidst rising costs!
content: Like many of you, I was sceptical about buying anything from them after reading so many reviews that painted a negative picture. I installed the app a year ago and during that time I’ve probably purchased over 1000 items, and in all that time only needed to request a refund on 1 damaged item. The app itself is intuitively designed to gamify receipt of discounts, but even the least astute user will quickly recognise the model of gamification used is “everyone’s a winner” - I doubt it would have been as successful 20-30 years ago, but it does hook you, and again to reiterate - I’ve had some amazing deals, spent far too much money, and if you are a fellow ADHDer I hope you have more discipline and self-control than I do! Giving it 5 stars for all round cost-saving, blatant targeting of neurodivergent shoppers, but selling items that have brought moments of hilarity, enabled me to buy bespoke gifts for staff in the office, and I now own a collection of Pixel light sabres for a fraction of the cost. So many sellers are local stockists in the UK, so I’ve even had items arrive within 2 working days - and for those larger items being sent by land, keep an eye on the tracking updates as there’s nothing quite like realising the banjo you’ve purchased has had visited more countries than you have!! In seriousness, set limits on what you’re spending, take advantage of the cash back offers - they really do work as promised, you just need to complete daily logins to complete the rewards in full. Final thought - if you want pristine packaging and levels of presentation that reflect what you might expect from high street store purchases in the UK, then this retailer and app probably isn’t for you!

title: How to get free stuff!! I’m obsessed!!
content: I love this site. For the first half year I couldn’t figure out why I wasn’t getting free gifts. I learned so much from my own research. Take a screenshot so you remember what they told you to do, such as type “claimcredit” in search. Usually no spaces. Definitely check for great reviews for purchases. I rarely are disappointed with this.

title: Mostly good but on deals they started adding app glitches to get you to exchange gifts for coupons
content:
The problem is that  on occasion when I went to claim the gift for that next day it would open that page then instantly display that I have exchanged it for coupons.
Now, it’s very different when it doesn’t do this.
When I open the page when it doesn’t do this I get to click to claim the gift then I get the two options.
After this happened once I screen recorded the next two which didn’t do this.
After that I assumed maybe it was me with the last one so no longer screen recorded.
Now apps can know if you’re screen recording for context.
On the last one it did it again and this seems the happen on the gifts worth more.
I open the page and instantly it says “you’ve exchanged it for coupons” something I’d never want to do or anyone.
The coupons aren’t money then are small amounts of money off an order, but these coupons already exist you do not gain even more coupons because more coupons isn’t more money off its just more coupons that you can only use on at the time.
A million pound of coupons will give you one couple relevant to the cost of your order… 10% off max… you get a bunch of coupons that you can choose one of them… giving you 5 £5 off on orders over £15 is one coupon giving you £5 off and you can choose one of those coupons, so why would you exchange a free item for this?
The customer service just play the roll of not understanding which they will be asked to do to save the company money.
Don’t do the offer if you can’t afford it.
You have lost a customer for life

content: それなりの商品が届きました。写真と違ってちゃっち(ショボい)い枕、足拭きマット、製氷皿など数点。大きな袋に乱雑に入れられており、箱などは潰れてました。あ〜あ、やっぱり値段なんだなぁと反省。旦那に言うと「中国系だと情報抜かれるぞ」と脅され、怖かったですがカードトラブルや海外から電話が掛かってくるなどの事はなかったです。2度と利用するつもりはなかったのですが、会社のイベントでサインペンや色鉛筆等の文房具が(個人的に)必要になり、安くて大量に入手したいが為に粗悪品覚悟で再度購入したんです。中国製品が多めでしたがそれ以外もありました。箱は潰れてましたが色鉛筆は大丈夫でした。写真とは違ってましたね。実際使ってみると色が薄かったけど値段で納得しました。ケースが布でできていてクルクルと巻けるような仕様でこれは絶対日本製じゃないと思える面白い物もありました。その後アプリは削除してたのですが、インスタの広告でシーインという通販サイトがあることを知りアプリをDLしてから何気にレビューを見ると悪くばかり。レビューを気にされない購入者さんもたくさんおられるようなので気になったら買ってみようと思います。シーインのレビューの中にtemuの文字を見つけたのでレビューしようと思いました。アプリを持っていないと書き込みができなかったので再度DLし、レビューし終わったら即削除します。ここでの皆さんのレビューをちゃんと見ていれば多分購入しなかったと思います。ですが、商品によってはいい物もあるのかもしれません。良いと書いておられる方もおられるので。

title: 参考になれば。
content:
1年ほど利用し、特に問題なく利用できています。
支払い方法はPayPalにしていますが、他で購入する際は毎回パスワードを入力するのに対し、こちらのアプリでは1回入力すると次回から自動的にログインされます。情報抜かれてる可能性もありますが、トラブルは起きていません。

購入する際の商品は見極めが大事で、商品名や説明欄、画像などしっかり確認することをオススメします。画像や商品名だけで判断すると全く違うものや一部のパーツのみが届くこともあります。
しっかり確認することさえ気をつければ失敗することも少ないです。
きちんと記載のないものは買わないほうが賢明でしょう。
またレビューも参考にするといいかもしれません。

返品返金については迅速に対応していただけます。
高額品については分かりませんが、2000円未満のものはきちんと手続きすればすぐでした。
私はいつもTEMUクレジット（アプリ内通貨？）に返金していただいてます。
破損があったり選択したサイズと違っていたり、違うものが届いていたりそもそも入ってなかったり。そういった際に返金手続きしています。

無料プレゼントについて。
友達紹介を何人分もしなければならないものと、コツコツ頑張れば紹介しなくてももらえるもの（ファームと魚）があります。
ある程度お買い物が必要かもしれませんが、今のとこ3回ずつほど無料でもらってます。
クリアする頃には最初に選択した商品が完売してることもあるので、どうしても欲しいものは購入し、あればいいかな程度のものを選択するといいかもしれません。

キャンペーンについて。
クーポンなどお得に買えるキャンペーンがたくさんありますが、個人的にオススメなのは○○％OFFキャンペーンとクレジットバックキャンペーンです。
たまにアプリを開いたときに出たり、注文商品を確認したときやそのページにあったりします。
私は結構買い物させていただいていますが、いつもこちらのキャンペーンを利用させていただいてます。
○○％OFFについては2円で購入できるキャンペーンが付属してるときがオススメです。
必ずしも通常価格よりお得に購入できる訳ではないので、価格を見比べながら選ぶといいと思います。
これらのキャンペーン時は好きなものを選べないときもある（限られた商品の中から選ぶ）のですが、最近閲覧・カートに入れたカテゴリがピックアップされやすい気がします。

梱包について。
1つの厚手ビニール袋に詰め込まれて発送されます。
物によってはダンボールや小箱に梱包してくれてます。
ダンボールについてはいつも臭いが気になりますが…。
ボコボコになってることもあるので、かなり壊れやすいものや精密機器は避けたほうがいいかもです。
ただすごく丁寧に梱包してくれてるときもあるので自己判断で。

発送について。
以前利用していた海外アプリより断然早いです。ほぼ1〜2週間で届けてくれます。
簡単な追跡も随時できるので、安心してます。
置き配には非対応みたいです。

最後に。
個人的には今後も利用していきたいと思いますが、心配な方は大手の安心できるところで購入するほうがいいと思います。
少しでも参考になれば幸いです。

title: Temu
content:
Overall, I’m rarely disappointed with what I buy from Temu. My only truly bad experience came when I ordered glass teapots as gifts. The first two arrived as boxes of shattered glass. Not necessarily Temu’s fault, the shipper just put them in a box with no foam, styrofoam or other protection. I had to fight to get a refund on the second teapot. I’m waiting for the last four teapots to arrive and I’m praying these arrive safely.  I shouldn’t have to prove myself based on the volume I order and retain.
Areas I would have Temu improve, get rid of computer generated customer service response and put in actual people to help customers. Second if I send you pictures of a broken item, then refund me without challenge and address the problem with the seller. Finally, don’t make games like Farmland so ridiculously ‘cheap’ by doing things like reducing the value of the ‘waterings’ (point earners) as the customer nears the goal. Keep it consistent throughout the game. I started Farmland (regrettably) and am frustrated by what I now need to finish. I probably will never engage in another TEMU game because of it. If you want to incentivize people to buy more through games, don’t frustrate them by changing the scoring schedule.
Overall I give TEMU a 4 - 5 for product and 4.5-5 on customer service.

title: しょうこんだましい
content:
どんどん買ってもらおうという努力がすごいポップアップが頻発。プレゼントしますとか言っておきながら、対象額購入して得られる何万円かのクーポンは、分割でしか使用できない。
正直な商品レビューしたら、掲載できないと言われるし、そもそもレビューの名前にメールアドレスを一部公開されるし、低評価レビューすると巧妙な仕掛けが待っている。次画面で注意しないと満点星に変わるようなシステム。

〈返品〉
返品対応に呆れを通り越して笑いしかない。
大袋に適当に梱包して
（スティック状のガラス製品は薄いプチプチ袋に入れられただけ）、
10点以上バキバキで届いた。

返金のために返送する際、
しっかり梱包して下さいみたいな注意画面がでてきて、
こっちのセリフだよ！

とつっこみました。

〈その後の追記〉
やっとリアルな担当者がチャットにあらわれ、1時間ほど話の通じない会話をし（仰っている事が支離滅裂、矛盾だらけで披露しました。）

その後に別の方が現れて、合計2時間半くらいチャットしました。
結果、解決はしましたが、
まずは、梱包しない→破損→返品再送システムないのでなとにかく返金！
というのはよろしくない。
ECサイトなら、
梱包する→それでも破損してしまった→では画像動画なり確認してもらい、返品交換！
というシステムになれば良いのにと思います。

きちんと対応して頂いたので、評価1からちょっとあげました。

↑
！！・・・からのどんでん返し

あの不毛なやりとりの後、結局返金されなかった。
その事でまた2時間チャット。
商品ページに、２個セットと記載があるから注文したのに、１個しか届かない。

そのことをなん度も担当者が変わるたびに言い、
結果、「１個しか届かないことが判明しました。確認してください」とカスサポに言われる。
商取引法とかそういう概念はないのかな？
購入時に商品ページに２個セットと記載があれば、
日本だと２個を客に届けなければ契約成立しないし、
あとこら「判明時しましたー！」
なんて言ってすむ話ではないし、
とにかくこの件について話をひっぱり商品を送らないわ、返信しないわ、返金するといっておいて確認するまで放置だもの。
さいていです。つかれた。

title: Große Auswahl, günstige Preise – aber mit Abstrichen
content:
Ich habe Temu ausprobiert und bin insgesamt zufrieden, auch wenn es ein paar Dinge zu beachten gibt. Die Auswahl ist riesig – von Elektronik über Haushaltsartikel bis hin zu Kleidung findet man fast alles, oft zu sehr günstigen Preisen. Die Bestellung und Bezahlung liefen problemlos, und auch der Versand war überraschend schnell, obwohl die Ware meist direkt aus dem Ausland kommt.

Allerdings merkt man bei manchen Produkten die günstige Qualität. Nicht alles entspricht dem, was auf den Bildern gezeigt wird. Deshalb sollte man die Bewertungen anderer Käufer genau lesen. Wer mit realistischen Erwartungen bestellt, kann hier echte Schnäppchen machen.

Fazit: Temu ist eine interessante Plattform für preisbewusste Käufer, aber man sollte gezielt auswählen und wissen, worauf man sich einlässt

title: Handy site for discount products
content: TEMU is a decent online shopping site. Comes in handy when shopping for small appliance and electrical needs. Bought several accessory things at good discount prices compared to some online sites and box stores. Items rate from solar lights to electrical tools appliances, porable usb batteries, ie ect... prices were decent, shipping good and timely. Products arrive well packed and in good condition in almost all cases. So far been decent and dependable when it comes for shopping, paying, small service and shipment. Haven't yet returned anything to see if return policies are good. May return one item so we'll see how that goes. As for the app, search engine and select ability of comparative items is good if not excellent for catalog of products. As for shipping costs, there are generally small shipping fees that may add up if not carefully especially if they are advertising for some secondary " off site" purchases with other companies warehouses. Other things may come with free shipping. There s a Temu club you can join for a small monthly fee if you ship that much to handle some shipping for free vs discounts on certain items to balance shipping costs. The site is somewhat archaic and has some agitation and distraction, when they offer "daily spins" for discount item purchases, redirection, and pop up ads for extra items if your not a member, and occasionally freezes and restarts that losses some shopping products causing some frustration. Not enough to turn it off and not come back but distracts and discerns once in a while.

title: Good, But Be Careful!
content:
Temu is good, and has a lot of cheap goods on sale, many of which are worth the cash!

However, there are two things you need to get ultra-cautious with:

1) triple-check the size and/or dimensions of what you are buying. It’s not always clear how big something is, so read the sizing carefully, and don’t confuse inches and centimetres, as similar products will use one or both, making comparing stuff hard to easily do.

2) Be careful using promotional offers, as they are often hideously unclear exactly what you are getting, and what you are paying for. You’ll got dozens of offers every single day, that seem great - e.g. items for just a penny, or even items for free - but the terms and conditions of how to obtain these, are a nightmare to interpret and fathom out! Whilst they are designed to get you to order more stuff, and thus spend more money, if the offers were clearer and simply explained, I might actually spend more.

At the minute, though, the offers look like cons, as they’re often confusing, elaborate, or need you to spin / gamble (for free) to see what bonuses they are actually giving you, as Temu piles freebies on top of bonuses on top of extras, yet they make it nigh impossible to discern exactly what it is you are going to get for free or at a reduced price, and what you are going to have to pay full-price for.

It’s also impossible to use free offers with orders you’ve just placed. The whole thing is utterly maddening, and I wish Temu wouldn’t obfuscate and hide stuff, because it looks deceptive! Be clear, be upfront, and be honest, and customers will spend. Don’t, and they won’t!

title: Love this App!
content: I absolutely love this app, some of the local sellers on it are liars but the app itself and its staff are amazing. I’m having to rebuild and replace all mine and my son’s belongings because my husband won’t give us our stuff which everything was paid for with my own money that he won’t allow me access to for years along with serious DA, DV, CC and SA! We literally had just the clothes on our backs when we finally escaped. Not only is this app cheap but if you know how to work it you can get what they call Temu Credits back on certain items you’ve brought. I have over $500 in Temu Credit and I’ve only been using the app since just before Christmas when we finally escaped! I’ve not only used it to start replacing our belongings but also helping other victims of DA and DV by buying items they might need. Everything I’ve brought so far apart from two items have been incredible quality including clothing and electrical equipment. And the thing with the Temu credits is there’s no exp date to use them by and you can spend them on anything you want in the app.

content:
半分は酷い品質の商品が届きます。

不良品については、
安いし、返送料無料で集荷来てくれて
返品出来るのはいいんですが…

問題点、注意点は下記です。

①不良品でも交換はしてくれません。
返金するから買い直せと言うスタンス。

②2100円以上ではないと注文出来ません。

③届くまで1週間前後。

④チャットサポートのみで、かなり待つ。
外人に当たると翻訳でほぼ通じない。
出来もしないのに複数チャット同時進行で
1ターン毎かなり待つし、理解力ない人だと1時間はざらにかかります。

なので、商品A1000円を欲しかった場合、
2100円にする為に他に1100円分足して買い物するしかないのですが…

商品Aが不良品だった場合、返品すると…

1000円返金するから再購入となりますが、
手元に商品Aを買うために買った商品だけが残り
商品Aを買うためには再度2100円にする為に他の物を買わなければなりません。

しかも
最初のが届くのに1週間、
返送が現地倉庫に戻って返金までに1週間、
再購入したのが届くのに1週間……

と、言うことがしょっちゅう起きます。

！！！重要！！！
1番酷かったのは、シーツを頼んだのに、
全く注文してないクッションが届きました。

1時間近く問合せても
届いていないシーツを送って欲しくても
再送出来ませんの一点張り。

挙げ句外人のメールサポートに引き継がれ、
引き継いだ外人は2~3分で
「厳正に調査しましたが間違えてませんのでサポート終了します」で一方的に終了されました。

時間とお金を無駄にしてもいい人のみ
利用するサイトですね。

届かない可能性や、不良品で時間をかけて購入を繰り返せる時間がある事を受け入れられる方はどうぞ。

必要なものは他で買い、あってもいいかなー程度の低価格なものを暇だから試そう！には向いてますw

title: Bester Online Shop der Welt
content: Alles ist hier bis ins kleinste Detail durchdacht automatisiert und man erhält unkompliziert Top Ware in einer riesigen Auswahl zu einem unschlagbaren Preis. Gefällt etwas nicht oder ist kaputt, wird es problemlos erstattet bzw. kann kostenlos zurückgegeben werden. Dazu kommen etliche Rabatte, nachträgliche Preisnachlässe und 5 Euro Verspätungszuschlag, sollte der Versand trödeln oder streiken. Das ist Shopping auf höchstem Niveau. Nur bei Kleidung wäre ich vorsichtig. Fast alles ist aus Polyester, fühlt sich wie Plastik an und lädt sich statisch auf. Die EU Größen passen aber meist, auch bei den Schuhen und die sind meist klasse.

title: Good products and customer service.
content:
Everything purchased so far has been good quality At excellent prices. Delivery is reasonably fast. One light plastic item was crushed and broken during delivery. Needed better packaging but return system worked well money refunded fast.
My only difficulty which I hope to sort soon, is that somehow I have created multiple accounts and cannot easily work out how to merge them. Makes keeping track of orders and offers harder. I think in trying to speed up process of setting up and ordering they have left it open to accidental multiple accounts. Needs a simple stage added in to help stop this.
The endless barrage of offers and deals and time limits took a while to get used to. Initially confusing but works well once you work it out. Wording of some messages needs better translation.

title: Great for deals if you choose carefully
content:
Temu sells a lot of stuff, and a lot of it is heavily discounted. Unfortunately there are a lot of counterfeits or very poor quality items that you might end up buying, but if you take the time to look through the reviews and see what other people have mentioned about it, it helps narrow down the choice for high quality choices.

Also some of Temu’s promotions are very solid in return value, while some of them are downright not worth it at all. Always look into the “free items” or “returned credits” conditions to get a clearer idea of what you’re getting in return. Personally I like the returned as credit promotions, and the free item ones usually aren’t that great unless it’s exactly what you were looking for. With the return in credits, you can use the credits to purchase what you were actually interested in.

Bonus tip: if you find a promotion that is actually worth it, like spend 65-75 dollars and get 50 dollar worth of credits back over 7 days, Temu usually only lets you choose from an infinite scrolling list in the promotions. A small way around that is to make sure you have all the items you were interested/ vetted to make sure they were reputable first loaded into your cart. Temu’s infinite scrolling will give you random choices but the algorithm is catered to items you’ve looked up or normally purchase, so if you happen to see that reputable item that is currently in your main cart, you know it’s a solid buy that you can add to the promotion’s cart.

title: 95% Happy!
content:
I am new to Temu. For the past couple of months I kinda went nuts with the tax refund & got so many nice things for very little cost-and several free items.
To get the best of what Temu has to offer, I highly recommend the following-
It is important to read the store reviews, the product reviews, look at the photos & videos sent in by purchasers, read the description of the product IN FULL! 2D means flat-for those that don't know-I've seen you on tiktok, lol. Check the measurements-because the one pictured is usually the biggest they carry & there's several choices for sizes (for wall hangings, clothes, drapes, figurines-everything!) The prices are amazing, and if you shop right, your purchases will be too! I opened one box today that I was awe struck by-honestly. It was a caligraphy set with green (fake but pretty) big rhinestones, a feather, several inks of different colors, a feathered caligraphy pen and a non feathered one, a wax stamp, with waxes of many colors, an ink holder and pen holder made from brass. It is so beautiful & was under $20... just checked-it was $10!! Be careful and follow my tried and true plan. Only got two items I wasn't happy with-1 was free-normally the free stuff is fine & the other was some hanger for leggings that cost a buck. No biggy. I have gotten so many items and am 95% happy with my purchases. Happy with the delivery time, as well. For those with shopping addictions-do not follow the buy more and get more - they got me a couple times-but I felt me & my kiddo deserved our items. 🙂❤️✌🏼

title: Sneaky
content:
This is great for good deals on aesthetically pleasing cheap stuff. However it does try to trick you a lot to spend more money by trying to over load you with flashy gamified advertising that will entice you to add to your cart with the promise to “win” more money.
I’ve tried some of the promotions several times and it it even has a status bar that confirms you’ve spent “enough “ to “ qualify” for different promotions (like $100 credit if you buy just 3 more things) but when you buy those 3 things it will prompt you again to buy just 3 more things because the first thing that you bought didn’t add up to enough to get the hundred dollar promotion. So why would you tell me that I got it in the first place? I’ve canceled 3 orders over this, just on the principle!
Then, after I received one of my orders (that went apart of the earlier mentioned promotions) I left a 2 star review on a choker necklace because it’s scratchy and not as sparkly as the pictures make it seem. Just being honest. Well when I hit submit, the app suddenly flashed a prompt to change my 2 stars to a 5 star review and it happened so fast I hit “ok” without even realizing what happened. I went back to check and sure enough, my 5 star review was at the top and the comment said “eh. It’s alright”
Dose that sound like a 5 star review? lol
Luckily I could change it and of course they moved my review to where no one will ever see it. It’s just very dishonest practices, and after my last shipment I’ll be deleting Temu.

content:
Make sure you choose 4 stars and up for reliability. Read the reviews before you buy, always check the size chart and measurements. You can’t go far wrong doing this. Always received my parcels within the 10 days . Returns are easy, refunds are fast.
The only thing I would say is a negative is that the pictures of clothes and what you receive are not the same. Temu either need to send the material that is shown in the pictures and charge a little more for that quality or display the actual item that is being sent in the cheaper material.
Also, it would be good if they made leather foot wear and not cheap fake leather that doesn’t last long. I would like to see better quality, longer lasting foot wear being sold to so we have a choice.
Lastly I would like to see less plastic packaging used. It’s just too much for the planet.

content:

The second time, I also contacted TEMU and provided the delivery note from Royal Mail, but it didn’t contain any useful information. Despite repeatedly explaining the situation both times, TEMU refused to reship the items or issue a refund.

This has been incredibly frustrating, and I feel let down. I have done everything I can to prove that I never received my orders. I am requesting TEMU to refund my purchases or provide a reshipment immediately.

title: Beware
content: Don’t put anything in your basket that you definitely don’t want. I put stuff in the basket so that I didn’t lose it. My intention was to review it later and remove any items that I didn’t want or were duplicated. What I didn’t realise was that when you make your first payment, Temu will become an ‘automatic payment’ on your PayPal account. I didn’t realise this so was seriously upset when they took £364 from my PayPal account and sent me the entire contents of my basket. This included stuff that was the wrong size, duplicates, or just plain trash. Because I have mental health issues, I didn’t even think of sending it all back - completely my fault I know. But just beware of their ability to take an automatic payment for everything in your basket even if you haven’t gone through any kind of checkout process. Go to your PayPal account and disable the automatic payment option. Just want to add that some of the clothes are a nice material, but most are an unpleasant shiny polyester fabric. Quite revolting. And the sizing is definitely hit and miss. I will never shop with them again. Cass

title: Too good to be true
content:
When I first started looking at Temu. I had many reservations about so many things, but found myself wanting to purchase so many various products, I needed to ground myself, so decided to buy a few things, then see how it turned out. Waiting for my order I had moments doubting myself for the offers presented to me before the arrival of my order, I started to think I was scammed, as those prices seemed to be too good. Then my parcel arrived and whilst opening I thought don’t expect quality.  How wrong on every level I was.  It’s now my first choice, I have to set myself a budget to stick to, as I am always finding myself liking too many items, I’ve recommended site to family and friends which I would never usually do, yet Temu has analysed the market sector, understood the weaknesses in its competitors, been resourceful, they listened and understood what potential customers are looking for, then applied this strategy. with the ability to create affordable pricing. if you can find the negative mine would be the delivery to be quicker but really that’s due to me wanting it instantly. My challenge has been buying gifts and reminding myself that these purchases are intended for my loved one’s and not for me to become more self indulgent.  Temu truly fulfills every expectation that is required from an online site, with no compromise to their customers, especially facing a difficult financial period. They have become my first port of call and strongly recommend that you visit Temus site. I’m sure you would not be disappointed, the only problem is pulling yourself away, once you are on board.  I’ve not worn an outfit without receiving a compliment from someone.
I’m not articulate enough or able to find the right words as any disservice would be unjustified.
I can say that I am unquestionably be a returning customer for the unforeseen able future and that should speak volumes in itself

ダウンロードするだけで10000paypayポイントが貰えると言っていますが総額2万以上賭けなければもらう事は出来ません。

その為2万ゴールド貯めて1万PayPayポイントもらうとしても、高額商品ばっかりが購入画面に出て総額2万円以上で1万PayPayポイントが貰えます。

そして商品も最悪です。
広告に出てくる防水ワイヤレスイヤホンですが購入してから数週間後、水の中に誤って入ってしまった結果3秒で壊れました。どこが防水やねん。

このように詐欺商品を送りつけたり、簡単に壊れる物を送りつけてくるのでお勧めしません。他にもそもそも商品ではなく箱だけが正規のもので中にはプラスチックゴミが入っていたり、タブレットを購入したのにタブレット以外のものだけが送られてきた等のケースがあるので、絶対にダウンロードしない方が良いです。

他にもこのアプリをダウンロードして住所を
設定したら個人情報が抜き取られた。漏洩した
などの事件が発生してるので私は絶対にダウンロードしません。

お読みいただきありがとうございます。
長々と書いてしまい申し訳ございません。
皆さんも詐欺アプリには気をつけてください。

title: Its temu
content: Its temu, I dont know anyone who hasnt heard about this app. The prices have gone up like ali did. As expected. I wish they did better with shipping items, Id order a lot more stuff. I dont bc they cram everything into bags and anything fragile isnt marked as such so its a toss up if they will make it in one piece. I usually stick to buying crafting stuff, party favors. Their enamel pins are great quality and good prices. The customer service is good I havent had any issues so far. I do not like some of the random pop up spinning wheels. They trap you in and I have to restart the app and quickly click something to avoid the wheel. Also dont like how they basically false advertise “cash back” when they really mean 20% off coupons off 100 dollar order… that expire within a few days. The shipping speed has gotten longer as well. It use to come in a week, less than two. Now it takes two or more…Also hate that most of these sites have gotten rid of cotten clothing in favor of this horrible synthetic material. I cant wear any of the clothes the first time I did I got a terrible rash even with having washed them three times what ever is used is not good for sensitive skin. So if you can tolerate any fabric then the clothing may be worth it for you. Also do not like how the photos are many times misleading, but at this point I know, what ever I order will be WAY smaller than I am expecting. All that said I have spent wayyyyy too much money shopping on temu. Even if the shipping is longer sometimes its still my go to for specific items.

title: Not as bad as I expected.
content: I heard a lot of people say that this app is a scam, and while I can certainly see why they’d think that it actually isn’t a bad place to shop. I will deduct it a star though for one reason; they give you the illusion that you’re winning prizes. When you spin a wheel or pull the lever on a virtual slot machine they will ALWAYS rig it to have the best prize to make you think you got lucky, and they do this to pressure you into taking the deal before it expires. Sometimes they even have promotions where they offer you free items if you invite friends to the app or the event, don’t believe this though since they made this nearly impossible to win. They do have some games on this app where you water a plant or feed some fish for a while, which can actually get you some free items, granted they are cheap items but still free regardless. And I’m not referring to the ones you choose the moment you play the game for the first time, I mean the extra items they allow you to earn on the side. They make it to where you need to complete the side objective every day of one week to get it, which doesn’t really take up much of your time for each day you gotta do this. When it comes to the actual shopping, the prices are actually really good. I would recommend talking to their customer service bot about getting the checkout minimum removed though to make things more convenient for you. Anyway, that about sums this review, it’s a surprisingly fun app to shop on.

title: For the most part a great app, but some misleading promotions.
content: By and large, Temu offers quality products at fantastic prices, shipping is cheap (if not free) and expeditious, and some of their promotions result in some very desirable freebies. However, the majority of their promotions/deals are incredibly misleading. Their FarmVille promotion reeled me in by saying I was only $10 away from a bunch of free items, the first $9 passed by in under an hour, but the final $1 has taken me more than a week to get down to the final 5 cents, and each time the result of my efforts has been at least halved, if not reduced even more. I’m pretty close to what I hope is my last task, but I won’t be surprised if when I finish it only rewards me with 1 cent, leaving me to grind it out four more times, at which point I’m sure it will reward me with only half a cent, leaving me half a cent from my ultimate reward. Then I’m sure the tasks will reward me with maybe 1/10 of a cent the next four rounds, before surprising me with 5/100 of a cent on what I expect to be the final round and starting that infuriating process all over again. That, and the reliance on other people accepting your already embarrassing invitations are huge, huge aggravations and a disappointments that ultimately ruins what is otherwise a near perfect app.

content: Temu has some really cool stuff and their prices are cheap too. I have to say that it is better than Wish. But, I have two issues. (1) Sometimes, the pictures of the items are misleading. title: 私の中では1番良いショッピングサイトです。
content:
今のところこれと言った問題は無かったです。 商品の当たり外れはあるけど他のサイトに比べてかなり安く手に入るし、返品などの対応もめちゃ良いです。 商品の値段などは時間によって大きく変わったりします。数日前は2600円とかしたものが気づいたら1000円ほどになっていたり、逆のパターンもあったりするので買う時などは安くなるのを待つのも良いと思います。 商品が安いことあって質が悪いこともあるけど、その分安いし返品したいってしたらお金だけ返されたので気にしてません。私は1年前ほどから入れてましたが、商品のバリエーションがかなり増えました。 今まで売っていなかった商品が色々と買えるようになって来て、1年で何倍もの種類が増えたと感じました。 私はよく使うからか、最低注文額が設定されていなくて2円でも注文可能でした。 あとは商品を一つ割引されるイベント（シークレットカード）が結構あって、本革コード5m、横幅6mmの物が2円で買えたりしました。（商品一つ割引するのは招待とか何もしなくても出来る神イベント）でも友達を招待したり、餌や水をあげたりする物はゲットするのは難しいのでお勧めしないです。 あとは、やはり海外なので発送に時間がかかります。それでも送料は発生しないのでとても気に入っています。 最近は99%割引というイベントが頻繁に起きていて、600gのセレスタイトの原石や、200gのスモーキークォーツのクラスター、100gほどのアメジストクラスターなどが１つ2円という安すぎる値段で購入できています。
このイベントは上記に記したようになんの代償もなく行えているので本当に凄いです。
（1年ほど愛用していたおかげかわかりませんが）‥TEMUほど安いアプリはないと思います。もはや安すぎて不安になるレベルです。個人的には星を付けられるだけ付けたいです。 でもニュースでの事は気になりました。

Da helfen die guten Preise auch nicht.

title: Very deceptive
content: I gave 2 stars because many items are reasonably priced and decent. But you still get what you paid for. I ordered a hammock chair with pillows, but I received without pillows and it’s not usable. It’s like a child sized hammock.  Plus, I placed an order for an item that said it had low inventory. I ordered quickly, but after I placed the order they are now saying it’s out of stock. They are giving me a $5 credit for the item, which is more than what the item cost, BUT, I have to make a $69 purchase to get the credit for the item that went out of stock after I placed my order for it.  The promotions are very deceptive. They NEVER live up to the promotion promises and you can not win the games. May be able to win if you spend $1000+. So far Ive spent a couple hundred on items and they have not lived up to their end of the promises. They offer a certain amount in credits then they spread the amount out and put a time limit on it that you can only meet with more purchases. Or they will flat out say you have to make a purchase to get the reward, that you already made the purchase for. With the games, you win the needed credits very quickly at first, then they slow it down dramatically, so much that time runs out before you win. I’ve spent >2 weeks playing daily for 0.5% credit on a game and still no win in site. There’s games within the games that have the same tease, but they time out before you win, (as I said before, may be winnable if you spend $1000, but I’m not able or willing to test that amount out)

title: I love temu
content:
Temu is an online marketplace that has rapidly gained popularity due to its competitive prices and a vast array of products. The platform offers everything from electronics and fashion to home goods and beauty products, catering to a wide range of consumer needs.

**Pros:**
- **Affordable Pricing:** One of the standout features of Temu is its incredibly low prices. Many items are significantly cheaper than on other platforms, making it an attractive option for budget-conscious shoppers.
- **Diverse Product Range:** The variety of products available on Temu is impressive. Whether you're looking for the latest gadgets, trendy clothing, or home essentials, you're likely to find it here.
- **Frequent Promotions:** Temu regularly offers discounts, flash sales, and promotional codes, further enhancing the value proposition for shoppers.

**Cons:**
- **Product Quality:** The quality of products can be hit or miss. Since many items are sourced from various manufacturers, there's inconsistency in terms of durability and overall quality.
- **Shipping Times:** Shipping can take longer than expected, particularly for items that are shipped from overseas. This may be frustrating for customers used to faster delivery times from other e-commerce giants.
- **Customer Service:** Some users have reported issues with customer service, including slow response times and difficulties in resolving disputes.

Overall, Temu is a solid option for those looking to save money on a wide range of products. However, potential buyers should be mindful of the trade-offs in quality and shipping times. If you're patient and willing to take a chance on some items, Temu can offer significant savings.

title: No complaints from me.
content: I have now bought over 250 items from Temu and 75% have been 5*. Obviously there are times when “you get what you pay for” comes into play but if I’m paying literally pence for small items I don’t expect them to last a lifetime, even items I have received and realised were not suitable have been perfect for friends and family, so I’ve passed them on. I personally do not fall into that category!. Being disabled getting out and about isn’t always easy so for me shopping on line has always been a blessing and Temu is my go to place when looking for virtually anything these days.

author: Milojasper22

title: A very disappointing and risky experience
content:
I recently used the Temu app, and I must say, it was a thoroughly disappointing experience. The quality of the products offered on this platform is alarmingly poor. I ordered several items, and almost every one of them failed to meet even basic expectations. The materials were cheap, the items didn’t match the descriptions or images, and some products were downright defective. It’s clear that quality control is not a priority for Temu.

To make matters worse, after using this app, I started receiving scam calls from unknown Chinese numbers. This was alarming and led me to suspect that my personal information had been compromised through the app. It’s highly concerning that a platform like Temu not only sells substandard products but also appears to expose its users to potential security risks.

In summary, I cannot recommend Temu. The poor product quality and the potential risk to your personal information make it a platform to avoid. If you value your privacy and expect a certain standard of quality from online purchases, steer clear of this app.

title: 中国「拼多多」の海外版
content:
TEMUは、中国の大手オンラインショッピングプラットフォーム「拼多多（Pinduoduo）」の海外版として運営されています。拼多多は、中国国内で非常に人気のあるプラットフォームで、低価格の商品をグループ購入や共同購入の形で提供することが特徴です。このモデルをもとに、TEMUは海外市場向けに展開されています。
注意⚠️
1.	品質のばらつき:
•	TEMUは幅広い商品を低価格で提供していますが、その品質が一貫していないという声があります。一部の商品が期待外れだったり、写真と実物が異なる場合もあります。

2.	配送の遅延:
•	配送が遅れることがあるため、予定よりもかなり遅れて商品が届くケースがあります。特に国際配送の場合、時間がかかることが多いです。

3.	カスタマーサポートの対応:
•	サポートの対応が遅い、または不十分だと感じるユーザーもいます。特に返品や返金の対応に時間がかかる場合があるようです。

4.	誤配送や商品不良:
•	間違った商品が届いたり、不良品が送られてくることも報告されています。これに対する対応がスムーズでないと、トラブルに発展することがあります。

5.	個人情報やセキュリティへの懸念:
•	新興のショッピングプラットフォームであるため、個人情報の管理やセキュリティ面での不安を感じるユーザーもいます。

6.	返品・返金手続きの難しさ:
•	返品や返金の手続きが煩雑で、手間がかかると感じるユーザーもいるようです。特に海外に返品する必要がある場合、費用や時間がかかることが懸念されます。

7.	偽造品の懸念:
•	TEMUで販売されている商品の一部が、正規品ではない可能性があるという指摘もあります。特にブランド品や電子機器に関しては、偽造品のリスクが懸念されることがあります。

これらの点を考慮すると、TEMUでの購入には一定のリスクが伴う可能性があるため、特に高額商品を購入する際には注意が必要です。

title: 良く利用してます
content:
雑貨や服、猫グッズを安く買えるので良く利用してます。シーリングスタンプグッズを安く買えたのがとても嬉しいです。
メルカリだと高いので今まで手が出せなかったのですが、ようやく趣味を始める事が出来ました。
写真の色合いは違う事がありますが、それはもう仕方ないですね。
冬物で大きな毛布を購入しましたが凄い技術で圧縮されて小さく届きました。
軽くて暖かくて気に入りました。暖房を使わなくても暖かく眠れるので重宝します。
今月大きなキャットタワーを購入した時に壊れて届きましたが、すぐに返品、返金処理してくれたので良かったです。
キャットタワーが手に入らなかったのは残念でしたが、対応はとても早いです。
そして海外から来るのに届くのが早いです。
離島に住んでますが、発送から約1週間で届きます。助かります。

追記: 約11ヶ月利用しています。
毎月何かしら購入してますが購入した商品のうち1/3は微妙だったりダメなものでしたが2/3は良い、とても良い商品です。
ただモヤモヤする事が一点。レビューです。
商品のレビューを事細かに丁寧に書いてもその商品が製造停止や出品停止になると書いたレビューも無駄になります。誰にも読まれる事のないレビューを私は真面目に書いていたのかと、、、ダメだった（壊れてたり）商品の悪い評価を書くとすぐに商品ページが無くなります。悪い評価を残さない為でしょうか。
レビューもあまり信用できませんね。
悪い評価するよりその都度返金してもらう方が賢そうです。
ネックレスなんて特に酷いものでしたよ。錆びてましたし、飾りが抜け落ちてるのもありました。安くてもこれじゃあ意味がありませんね。
アクセサリーを買うのはやめました。
このレビューは消されない事を祈ります。

猫の寝床やスローフィーダー皿（早食い防止皿）などはとても良かったです。
猫は吐き戻しが多い動物で寝床もよく汚すので年に1回、2回買い替えられる安さはとても助かります。
市販の約半額〜1/3の値段で買えました。
良いもの悪いものを見極めて買い物を楽しむと良いと思います。

title: Temu – Gute Auswahl und attraktive Angebote, aber mit etwas Geduld
content:
Ich habe kürzlich Temu entdeckt und bin insgesamt zufrieden mit dem Einkaufserlebnis. Die Plattform bietet eine breite Auswahl an Produkten – von Elektronik über Mode bis hin zu Haushaltswaren – und die Preise sind oft sehr konkurrenzfähig. Besonders praktisch finde ich die Möglichkeit, mit Credits zu bezahlen, die man durch spezielle Aktionen oder Einkäufe sammeln kann.

Das Guthaben-System funktioniert gut, und ich konnte meine Credits für einige interessante Produkte einsetzen. Die Benutzeroberfläche ist übersichtlich, und die Bestellung verlief reibungslos. Die Lieferung war in der Regel pünktlich und die Artikel entsprachen den Beschreibungen.

Ein kleines Manko ist, dass die Vielzahl an Angeboten und Sonderaktionen manchmal überwältigend sein kann. Es ist wichtig, regelmäßig nach neuen Deals Ausschau zu halten, um keine Vorteile zu verpassen. Zudem könnten die Produktbewertungen noch etwas detaillierter sein, um eine bessere Kaufentscheidung zu ermöglichen.

Insgesamt ist Temu eine empfehlenswerte Plattform, wenn man auf der Suche nach guten Angeboten und einer großen Produktauswahl ist. Mit etwas Geduld und Aufmerksamkeit kann man hier wirklich tolle Schnäppchen finden.

Ich hoffe, das entspricht deinen Erwartungen!

title: Excellent value for most items bought.
content:
Almost everything I’ve bought from Temu has been great value. I have marked them 4 / 5 stars due to the fact that their packaging leaves a lot to be desired.
A hat I bought, delivered in a plastic bag, was crushed beyond repair; the pointed heels of shoes, also in a plastic bag, had poked through and been damaged themselves, got thoroughly soaked along with everything else in that order and also damaged some of the other items in the bag; a metal sign arrived bent out of shape.
Temu were very understanding and helpful with arranging quick returns/replacement or just refunding. I would much rather they packed everything in boxes!
The only clothing I’ve bought is swimwear and for those items, I would impress upon everyone to buy a size or two larger than usual. Clothes & swimwear can be taken in, but generally (these days especially) cannot be let out!
Overall, extremely pleased with most of my purchases.

title: Amazing prices and amazingly bad products
content: First of all, I’m the first person to agree that prices on this app are amazing, and the offers and deals are also pretty insane. However, the products on here are SHOCKINGLY BAD. I placed two orders so far (10 items in total), six of which are either completely unfit for purpose from the get go, or started malfunctioning after just a couple of weeks. These include wall lights that are way too sensitive and constantly fall off, an electric wine bottle opener that doesn’t go deeper than 2cm into the bottle (let alone removing the cork), socks that had holes in them after two wearings, and phone screen protectors that form air bubbles as a result of me using the screen!!! Credit where it’s due, the return process is pretty straightforward. But be warned - shopping here is like buying lottery, you have no idea whether you’ll get something useable . GOD ONLY KNOWS where all the raving reviews on these items came from. Lastly, as a user of PDD (the company’s sister app in China) which has genuinely good quality and good value items, I’m utterly bewildered at the complete absence of quality control of the items they choose to sell on temu. All the bargains in the world would not tempt me to use them again.

title: 真相をまじめに書きます
content:
色々と使って見ての感想にプラスして、ネットでのウワサ、ブロガーの記事、YouTuber達の使って見た　以上を更に見てきて、そして継続して使っている視点での感想です。ご参考に──

Q.怪しいんでないの？
A.不安な人はクレカ以外の支払いが選択できます。主はApple Pay挟んで支払ってます。クレカでは細かく明細をいつも見てますが、不正な支払いはないです。

P.S.安すぎる・梱包が雑いといった、日本からの考えではありえないためにどうしても怪しいと思えてしまうのは至極当然ですね。

Q.なんで主は使うの？
A.家電系はおすすめしません。ガジェット系ですね。中身の容量や電子部品なんかは、解体や接続しないと見えないですから。そこはパチモンが多いです。では何故使うのかというと、ちょっとした猫ミームのぬいぐるみや、ちょっとあれば便利なアイテム(DAISOではあるようでないような物)は使えます。『変わったもの』『ネタ』『気分転換グッズ、ファッション』というイメージです。

Q.使っていて困ったことは？
A.Temuはテム内でとにかく完結させたい傲慢な欲求がとにかく強い（苦笑）　なので、まあ通知でセールやアプリ開いて〜が多いです。これはまずOFFにしましょう。バッテリーをバックグラウンドで食うだけです。あと、価格はしょっちゅうすぐ安くなるので、「もうすぐ売り切れです」とかは基本無視OK。一番困った点は、スマホのバッテリーを消費することです。先ほどのように通知OFF、バックグラウンド通信系を切ってしまえば、開いている時以外は干渉しません。ただ、開いて閲覧している分には普通の消費ですが、以下強調──!
“Temu内にあるゲームを遊ぶと熱を食う”です！！
何それという方に簡単に説明すると、Temuにはざっくり２種類ゲームがあります。お魚パクパクとファームです。このゲームはそれぞれひたすら作業系のそこいらのゲームアプリと同様のしょぼいゲームです。何故あるのかというと、これを進行させてクリアすれば無料で好きに選択した商品を貰えます(これは実際に貰えました）。ただ、TikTokやYahoo!知恵袋にもアンサーにあるように、これがまたケチ臭くイケズで、クリアが近くなるにつれよりシビアにゴールを遠のくように設定されてます。これがうんざりしてゲームを辞める人も多いでしょう。ようは、暇つぶし程度のもので、人との待ち合わせや電車内での隙間時間に進行させる程度のゲームと思えば気楽ですし、ストレスフリー。ただ、これが馬鹿デカくバッテリー消費するから気をつけてねーということです。

Q.商品て本当に届くの？壊れてない？
A.梱包がダンボールでなく、鼠色の袋に入れてあるだけなので、雑いです。それの所為も相まって、開封して既に壊れている・破れている・割れているといった不良品もたまーにあります。価格が安すぎるので、そういったクオリティと初めから理解して利用してやりましょう。靴やズボンは皮やジーンズでなくゴムが多いです。会社の人に見せたら「何か変わってませんそれ!?」といろんな人に突っ込まれます（笑）

Q.不良品が届いたり、納得しない物は返品返金できるの？
A.シンプルにできます。こっちからコンビニに行くわけでなく、佐川さんやヤマトさんとTemuは契約しているので、Temuが返品返金までの流れをわかりやすい画面で案内します。3ステップくらい。ダンボールに商品とその商品の袋に貼られてるバーコードも一緒に梱包→配達員さんを好きな日程と時間指定→取りに来られ渡すと完了→個人差ありますがすぐに返金されます。
※注意点として、コンビニ支払いだと現金返金は原理的にされないため、Temu内にあるTemuクレジット(ようはポイントのようなもの)にして変換されます。

以上を参考になれば幸いです。

title: Too easy to buy something you don’t want and too hard to fix it
content: Temu makes it easy to buy but very difficult to correct mistakes. If you’ve just made a purchase, you have a chance to add other items to your order at a deep discount. If you click on an item to get more details, it’s added to your order and your card is charged. You’ll have to request a refund. If you add an item to your cart and remove it, you may have to remove it several times. There’s a Buy Now button that’s very easy to accidentally press. Your card is immediately charged and you’ll have to request a refund. There aren’t enough purchase confirmation steps which I believe is by design. I’ve deleted all my payment information from the app hoping I don’t make any more unintentional purchases. There’s no chance to really cancel anything. Also, your shipment may be incomplete which I think is also by design. You have to provide the package information and since they usually ship an order in multiple shipments, you may have discarded those packages before you realize you didn’t receive something. Yes I’ve found some good prices but I have to be very careful when using the app. I’m constantly checking my cart to delete things I didn’t want and checking my order history to make sure I didn’t pay for something I didn’t want. Every time, I’ve found something I didn’t want and since I don’t have this issue on other apps, I believe it’s them and I believe it’s intentional. If they can sneak in a few unintentional purchases and make the refund process difficult, they can make more money.

title: Eigentlich ganz gut, aber….
content:
Die fast komplette von mir bestellte Ware war bis jetzt in sehr gutem Zustand und guter Qualität. Wie bei anderen Onlinehändlern (wie z.B. Amazon) greift man auch hier aufgrund übermotivierter Werbung mal ins Klo. Dafür kann die Plattform eher weniger was. Schaue aber immer gern rein.
Aber:
Die immer gleichen Werbebotschaften und „Gutscheine“ (natürlich erst für die nächste Bestellung) sollen für weitere Bestellungen sorgen. Ich weiß auch nicht, warum ich ein „Freund“ bin. So werde ich in den Mails gerne genannt. Die Flut der Mails ist echt zu viel und gern auch mal Veräppelung.
Was absolut nervt und mich von weiteren Käufen abhalten wird, ist die ständige Erhöhung der Mindestbestellwertgrenze. Die Grenze lag anfangs bei 10 Euro. Mittlerweile bin ich bei 25 Euro gelandet. Diese Art der „Anerkennung“ für Kunden, die öfter bestellen, ist für mich völlig unverständlich. Stammkundschaft scheint hier nicht so erwünscht. Da such ich mir lieber ein anderes Geschäft.
Schade…

content: There are a lot of things being said about Temu right now, but I have done an extensive search amongst my friends for someone who has experienced these issues personally and I have not found anyone. I am delighted with the Temu app and experience and watch this space for updates on my refund and how long it took. So far the response from Temu is excellent, they are quick and friendly and understanding about someone who is willing but not very able when it comes to shopping online.

content: Been using Temu and App since January 2023.  Told everyone about it as was so impressed.  Have used others (two competitors) yet I found many of their descriptions misleading. content:

title: Nothing ventured, nothing gained
content: I started ordering from Temu about six weeks ago. There delivery by UPS and the USPS are fantastic and accurate.  I have spent about $500 on various products as a test before I bought more expensive items. It is vary frustrating trying to get the point across that a purchase with parts missing is worthless. Only a partial credit was offered. I was not allowed a supervisor and said no further orders would be placed. Another rep came on the chat and said a complete product would be shipped immediately. This took over an hour and may be the plan. It did arrive complete and quicker than normal.  Ontrac is the local delivery service.  Imho they are not reliable or trustworthy.  They are hitting under50%. One delivery never showed. They did not provide a photo of delivery and I have cameras on my property, although I live in a good neighborhood.  It took almost two hours between the two companies.  Ontrac backed their driver on a delivery of a one inch cube.  Temu replaced the 24lb package.    The latest incident said delivery was made at 10:36 AM. I was at home and spent almost two hours trying to get the point across that it was not delivered here. At 4 PM I was walking in my neighborhood when a stranger came up and handed my package that was delivered to his house. Neither TEMU nor ONTRAC will acknowledge this error , nor apologize for it. Both sent notice that delivery was made to my home.  Due to this lack of communication, I will no longer be ordering. I have one order in progress and am hoping for the best.

title: Please read!
content:
I found Temu to be incredibly frustrating to use. The app is cluttered and unintuitive, making it difficult to navigate and find what you're looking for. Product listings are often inaccurate or misleading, leading to disappointment upon delivery. Customer service is virtually non-existent, with slow response times and unhelpful support staff. Overall, I would not recommend Temu for anyone looking for a reliable and enjoyable shopping experience. Another aspect that disappointed me about Temu is the lack of quality control. Many of the items I purchased turned out to be of inferior quality, and some even arrived damaged or defective. Additionally, shipping times were excessively long, with no option for expedited delivery. Overall, my experience with Temu left me feeling frustrated and dissatisfied. Despite its promises of cheap shopping, Temu fails to deliver on multiple fronts. The app is plagued with technical glitches and crashes, making it nearly impossible to complete a transaction smoothly. Furthermore, the advertised discounts often turn out to be misleading, with prices fluctuating unpredictably during checkout. The customer review system is unreliable, with many fake or incentivized reviews skewing perceptions of product quality. Overall, Temu's lack of transparency and poor user experience make it a regrettable choice for anyone seeking affordable shopping options.

Thank you for your time😅. Have a good day/night

content:

title: The app is great but the shipping
content:
Temu is pretty great. I have found some pretty great items on Temu. I have to say that I have been  enjoying Temu and have spent a lot of time browsing the App and have bought quite a lot on it from kitchen gadgets to clothing. I have bought puzzles to purses. While I expect my items to take awhile for shipping do to the fact that it is coming from mainland China the lack of information for shipping and tracking does get frustrating. Also about half of my packages DO NOT arrive on time. The company offers $5.00 credit when your package does not arrive by the date that it is due to arrive which is nice but is not really nothing when your packages are constantly late. Currently I am waiting for 3 packages to arrive. I had 2 shipments that was split into 3. All of them are late. 1 is suppose to arrive by tomorrow, Monday but is not due to arrive until Tuesday. The other 2 do not even have tracking information with the post office for the last 4 days. Both of them were due to be delivered by Tuesday or in 2 days. It looks like Temu will owe me some more credits. They have already in the past when I package full of Christmas stocking stuffers came 11 days late. It was due to arrive December 9th but did not arrive until December 20th. I was beginning to panic a little then.
Either way as I am waiting for my next round of packages to arrive from Temu I did my reviews on all 75 items that I have recently purchased. I am very happy to continue browsing the site for more purchases. Some worth them money and are very nice items and some maybe not so much. Either way it is worth the effort and is fine site.

author: TJSWisconsin

title: Erstbestellung hat mich überzeugt
content:
Insgesamt habe ich vier Produkte bestellt. Eine Fleecemütze (leider etwas klein-gab es nur in Einheitsgröße), 5 T-Shirts als Unterhemden, 2 Sport T-Shirts und eine Hundedecke zur Abdeckung unseres Betts.

Von der Qualität war ich positiv überrascht. Die T-Shirts passen perfekt und lassen sich angenehm tragen. Den 80% Rabatt für die erste Bestellung hat sich für mich voll gelohnt. Wenn sich das bei weiteren Bestellungen bestätigt, werde ich dort regelmäßig bestellen. Die Lieferzeit mit 10 Tagen war für mich auch akzeptabel, da ich von vornherein wusste, dass die Lieferung aus China kommt. Auch war ich über den Sendungsverlauf immer informiert und konnte hier sehen, dass die Lieferung nicht per Schiff, sondern per Luftfracht nach Europa kam und von der Niederlande zu mir nach Hause geliefert kam.

Nach dieser ersten Erfahrung ist TEMU eine Empfehlung. Allerdings hatte ich aufgrund von Erfahrungen mit anderen Internetanbieter aus China durchaus etwas „Bauchgrummeln“.

title: 「TEMUクレジットに返金」に注意
content:
返品する際に「TEMUクレジット」に返金を選ばせようとしてくるので注意して下さい！

TEMUクレジットはTEMU内でしか使えず日本円に払い戻しもできないので、何度もTEMUで買い物をする方でなければ価値の無い仮想通貨です。
コンビニ支払いにすると返金はこのTEMUクレジットしか選べません。
クレカやPayPalで支払えば「元の支払い方法に返金」で日本円に返金されますが、返金方法を選ぶ際に「TEMUクレジットに返金」という選択肢が二度も出てきます。

SHEINであればSHEIN内のウォレットクレジットは元のPayPalやクレカに返金できるので、SHEINの方がよっぽど信用できます。
それにSHEINはしょっちゅう割引クーポンを出していますので、同じ商品でもSHEINの方が安い場合が多いです。
TEMUでは購入した商品について競合他社の方が安ければTEMUクレジットに「だけ」なら返金してくれるらしいですが。

返品しなくて済むとか無駄金使っても気にしないなら気にする必要はないかと思います。
ただTEMUの商品説明はGoogle翻訳のようで分かりにくい上に、梱包も雑に袋に突っ込んであるだけなので、説明と違う商品や壊れた商品が届く可能性が高いです。
海外通販ならそれは仕方ないですし、返品無料なので良いのですが、とにかくTEMUクレジットだけは困りものです。
ちなみにクレジットと無料ギフトを獲得、というものはどれも新規TEMUユーザーを何人も紹介しないとクリアできません。もちろんファームランドもそうです。

【追記】TEMU公式からのコメントがついていますが、コンビニ支払いだと絶対にTEMUクレジットにしか返金できません。PayPalでもクレカでもしつこくTEMUクレジットに返金させようとしてきます。本当に注意して下さい。

title: Shopping is great, but Temu policies and offers are deceptive
content:
I have been ordering from Temu for quite some time, and for the most part I love it. The prices are good, and I’ve rarely had a problem with an order. Those times I have experienced a problem Temu has quickly made it right. However, even their customer support agents don’t understand Temu’s arbitrary policies. For instance, Temu has a price adjustment policy that you are told in plain language that, if the same item you purchased is lowered by the seller within 30 days, you will receive a refund for the difference. But then when it arbitrarily isn’t applied the customer support agent has to send you a different policy that would take a team of mathematicians to figure out! title: Good but stay away from the games!
content:
I was amazed at how good the quality was on my first few order. Things did get a little worse as the orders went on but even if the sizes were off, the prints were bad or the items weren’t as described, they refunded pretty quickly on their easy return system but…

The free gift games are the scam part. They’re designed for you to sign up every friends you have, then bombard them with countless links on a daily basis to give temu free marketing. I’ve signed up 15 friends, played every day for 7 months, collected all the bonuses and linked with countless existing users to join in but the rules keep changing where you need to add MORE friends and annoy the ones you have with dozens of links a daily!! I’m still at least another month off and the prizes I wanted to win (A Drone) has been discontinued, leaving me with tacky options I don’t even want, for the value of $26.

In short, buy stuff while the prices are low and don’t waste your time on the “free stuff”.

I have not had any data leaks show up in any way connected to Temu so ignore the rumours and join a fun shopping experience!!!

title: 詐欺まがいの行為が許されるアプリ
content: SHEINや7s Goods等と違って毎日チェックインしてポイントをもらえるだとか、ミニゲームに挑戦してポイントをもらえる等はありません。ネット上でよく見る「5個無料」などは人を誘わなければいけません。1人新規で招待してもまだ「5個無料」の条件には達しません。だからTikTokなどで「交換しましょう」という内容のものをよく見ると思います。なぜなら何人も何人も誘わなければポイントが付与されないからです。それにも関わらず「お客様同士のトラブルには一切関与しません」という対応です。私は番号をお互いに検索し合ってお互いにポイントが入るようにしましょうという誘いに乗りましたが、相手が私の番号を検索することはありませんでした。つまり相手にのみポイントや特典が付与され、私には何も入ってきませんでした。相手のSNSのURLやTemu内での相手のユーザー名まで自分でまとめ提出したにも関わらず、詐欺まがいの行為をした人には「ペナルティは課せない」そうです。知名度が低いし「5個無料」と掲げている外国企業は警戒されなかなか招待に乗ってくれる友人がいませんでしたが、彼女たちが正解でした。少なくとも詐欺まがいの行為が罷り通るネットショップは、私は怖くて使えないです。即削除しました。

title: Great service.
content: The delivery and returns is very good, the clothing I have bought is really good quality and sizing is just about spot on for me. The jewellery I have bought it's cheap and looks great for one wear stones fallout and it also arrives with stones missing. CCTV camera was great arrived with no memory card and cost £44 to watch on smart phone, CCTV door bell needs constantly charging up so no use, selfie stick arrived great but didn't work. Somethings are great but also somethings are a load of rubbish. It's also so cheap I've not bothered sending stuff back got a draw full of stuff that I should have really sent back instead it will end up in the bin. One other thing they bombard you with offer's,  emails, WhatsApp, text messages send you offers which when you try to use them you have to send more and more and end up with 2p off your order. If you leave something in your basket you get messages to death telling you your basket is calling. Do not be drawn in as when you look at the basket you end up filling it again and again. I have spent over £1000 quid in three months I have now blocked everything except emails as it's turned into an addiction. Be warned but the clothes are really well made and look good on.

title: Leider für mich (und viele andere) nicht nutzbar..
content:
Wenn man Wohnhaft ist in Frankreich (oder einem anderen Land) aber keine Telefonnummer von diesem Land hat, ist es nicht möglich einzukaufen. In meinem Fall lebe ich in Frankreich, habe aber noch eine deutsche Nummer (was in Europa recht normal ist durch eu roaming und flat), kann aber in Frankreich nur eine Frz. Nummer angeben. Die Ländervorwahl lässt sich nicht ändern. So hab ich mir Sachen von mehreren hundert Euro ausgesucht und im Warenkorb kann ich wegen der Nummer den Einkauf nicht abschließen. Wäre super wenn man einfach die Vorwahl auswählen könnte und diese sich nicht abhängig macht von dem Wohnort. Auch etwa 300 weitere Personen alleine hier in meinem Betrieb sind betroffen, die es nicht nutzen könnten, wenn sie denn wollten.

Update: ich nutze nun irgendeine Nummer aus Frankreich, bin dadurch zwar nur per mail erreichbar aber erste Bestellung hat geklappt. Alles super 👌 Sobald ich meine Handynummer eintragen kann gibts 5* 👍

title: Value for money
content:
First time I’ve used this app. I bought 3 things totalling just over £20. I was a bit sceptical so didn’t want to spend too much just incase it was too good to be true.

Firstly the prices are great and there is so much choice. There are things on there that you didn’t know you needed until you saw them. Gadget heaven 😀 there is free delivery if you spend a certain amount.

I was given a delivery period and was informed I would get a credit if the items came later than stated. One of the items came before the stated time and the others on the first day of the delivery window. I was able to track the deliveries via evri.

The items themselves were exactly as stated in the write ups on the app. The quality is fair. In fact I probably could have spent more money on other sites for the same quality products. So I’m very happy with the purchases.

I’ve had no problems with my first order so can’t comment about customer service but prices paid and the communication re delivery has been spot on.

I’m not sure how this money gimmick thing works. If I score for free money great but I’m more than happy with the prices paid and the quality of the products.

I wouldn’t hesitate to purchase from Temu again and would recommend giving them a try at least once.

title: So much better than expected
content:
I don’t usually review apps, but I’ve been really impressed with this and today found another feature that made me decide to review it.

At first I thought this was a scam, prices just seemed too cheap, but I looked it up on trust pilot and decided to give it a go (using a credit card - just in case!!). My order arrived before the deadline they had given (in less than a week) which was a pleasant surprise, and the items (dresses, a pair of boots and a couple of kids bits) actually looked like the pics. The quality isn’t incredible but for the price I was impressed.

Here’s my favourite parts about it:
- prices are great.
- free shipping (and the only minimum order size I’ve come across so far was £10, currently it’s offering me on any order).
- there’s constant discounts and coupons available (tip - if you’re looking at a big order, often they give you a coupon after you’ve ordered so split it into two orders and use the coupon from the first order for the second half of the stuff)
- returns are super easy and free
- they do a price guarantee thing so if the price drops in 30 days from ordering they will refund you (that’s what I discovered today). You have to go into your orders and click on ‘request price adjustment’ but then it just lists any items that have changed price, you click submit and that’s it, you get a credit back.

The only thing I would say is read the descriptions carefully. Sometimes pictures might show multiple items (especially on kids stuff) but it’s only actually for one, or you have to select a certain size etc.

Enjoy!

title: Package lost & reorder price doubled
content:
I placed my first order and waited for it’s delivery. It was being delivered by Evri and two days in a row i received the message that they would deliver it the next working day. Both days this did not happen and then I received no updates after that. Temu did give me £5 credit as it was past when it was supposed to arrive and they apparently reached out to Evri to see where the parcel was. Most likely Evri had lost my package as they refunded me as Evri would not be able to deliver it. I would have preferred the option of having the order sent out to me again, however Temu automatically refunded me instead. This would have been alright however when i went to add the items back to my basket to reorder (except for 1 item which was out of stock) the total order price DOUBLED.

I contacted customer support over this and Alliandro did try to resolve this issue by asking me to place the order again, however as I explained to them, it would have cost me double the amount of money to reorder so I wasn’t happy with this resolution. Alliandro offered me a 20% off (up to £20) discount however, the order still would have been significantly more expensive than my original order, so I also wasn’t happy with this resolution. Unfortunately Alliandro was not able to offer any other resolutions, which is understandable as I’m sure they don’t have much power to resolve this, however it was disappointing.

I was looking forward to my first order from Temu, as well as placing future orders (instead of ordering from Aliexpress, since the delivery was supposed to be faster) however after this experience I will not be reordering my original order or placing any future ones. I hope Temu can partner with a more reputable courier in the future as well as fix the process for customers when stuff like this goes wrong in the future. For now though, I will be uninstalling the app.

title: I love it!! But…
content:
I have been using Temu for a few weeks now. If you aren’t familiar Temu gives out free items for inviting new people to the app. Great right? And I have done this many time and had even managed to win 8 free items of my choice! I was very happy for that, and I can assure you it’s not a scam. BUT, this whole idea is you get given three FREE items of your choice by inviting three friends to the app so they can take part in claiming prizes. So say I invite three friends, them friends invite three friends, and that goes for them three friends inviting other friend and so on.

❗️THIS IS A PYRAMID SCHEME!!!❗️

Temu is using you by leering you in by offering free items, so you invite as many people as possible to use the app. So in some way you are getting free items out of your on stupidity.

Now I don’t particularly have anything against the app because I have ordered things off temu for cheap prices and I have had pleasant experiences. And even if your package gets delayed they will usually give you credit ( I received £5 due to a delay!). It’s very similar to aliexpress, shein, wish ect… So this isn’t particularly a review to complain, but mainly just to tell people that this app is a blatantly clear pyramid scheme, which is even illegal is one countries. So I just want to make you aware of the Temu’s ‘plan’. But excluding THAT I love temu it’s a great service, very affordable and has a wide range of products!! I would recommend this app, but remember, most of the time receiving free things have a catch!
